title: Key Features
use_cases: Use when brainstormining new concepts in a dedicated freeform interface
Use when needing to organize separate research threads into multiple named sessions
Implement when long conversations require condensation into dense learning material
Configure when switching between collaborative and critical AI feedback styles
content: A dedicated sidebar panel for freeform idea conversation with the AI. Supports multiple named sessions, a summarize button to compress long chats into dense material, and Co/Crit mode toggle for different AI personas.
